title: A ‘miracle’ or Chicago grit? In South America, a post-op pope shows endurance.
summary_full: Pope Leo XIV’s surgery appeared to infuse him with a sense of urgency and even vitality for his travels through Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, enamoring the faithful.
